Name: Joja Bus Recolor
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Pelican Town’s bus service has finally been restored, and Joja Corp was proud to help! After the bus is repaired, Joja makes a few minor branding updates.

[b]Config Options:[/b]
A config.json file is generated after launching the game once. You can edit it manually or with Generic Mod Config Menu.

[b]Seasonal:[/b]
[list]
[*]true: The bus changes with each season.[/*]
[*]false: Uses one year-round bus texture.[/*]
[/list]
[b]JojaRouteRequired:[/b]
[list]
[*]false: The bus recolor appears after either the Community Center or Joja bus repair.[/*]
[*]true: The bus recolor only appears after completing the Joja bus repair contract.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Want more Joja nonsense? Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/LeelooStardew/mods]my profile[/url] for more Joja-themed mods![/b]
